request: I'm a workplace inspector and my inspection schedule moves around constantly, so I need a fare I can change. Ottawa to Toronto on December 15th; the inspections start at eight the next morning. My manager approved it.

trip.organization: Ministry of Labour and Workplace Safety

sign_offs.name: Grace Liu
sign_offs.title: Manager, Eastern Region Inspections
sign_offs.subject: TRAVEL_PLAN

design_notes: Every non-changeable seat is sold out, so the lowest fare available (lines 558-559) is WestJet's changeable fare at $318. Whatever the 2020 flexibility note (lines 1399-1402) means, the traveller gets a changeable fare. Within Ontario: the manager's approval is on file (Chart 1).
